result_summary: For a physical cross block M with k-volume squared-minor weights, row marginals alpha_i, column marginals beta_j and Z_k=e_k(M^T M), if max alpha_i<=q/2 and k>2q, sharp Hausdorff-Young plus the volume-sampling Brascamp-Lieb determinant estimate gives ||p_Q||_infinity <= [k/(k-2q)] [B_beta prod_i H_q(alpha_i)]^(1/k) Z_k^(-1/(2k)) <= e q^(-1/2) k/(k-2q) Z_k^(-1/(2k)). This sharpens D' to 3e/[sqrt(2h)(3-4h)] Z_3^(-1/6) for 1/2<=h<3/4 and sharpens ungated D5 to (5e/sqrt2) Z_5^(-1/10).

partner_account03_B02.application: For rank-two B with Delta=s1*s2 and a transverse row at distance eta, partner gives e3(core)=Delta^2 eta^2. For any larger physical cross block containing that core, Z3>=Delta^2 eta^2; under alpha_max<=h<3/4 the new D' compiler gives a robust arbitrary-extra-cross-direction density bound proportional to (Delta eta)^(-1/3). If two additional singular values are >=tau, D5 gives (5e/sqrt2)(Delta eta)^(-1/5)tau^(-2/5).

first_unpaid: High-volume-coloop/effective-rank-at-most-four collar: surviving third exterior volume is concentrated at row marginal >=3/4 (or Z3 too small), Z5 is insufficient at target scale, and the two-sided packet may be exact span-aligned. Convert this concentrated Pluecker mass product-preservingly into an already-paid physical pair/triple, one-sided square-rank-two, grouped hyperbolic/star, or dependence-safe Schur fractional-potential resource.
